2607.18149.title: Differentiable Logic Gate Networks for Low-Latency EEG Classification on Edge Devices
2607.18149.paper_summary: Real-time EEG classification on edge devices is bottlenecked by the floating-point arithmetic of conventional neural networks. We investigated Differentiable Logic Gate Networks (Diff-Logic) as a hardware-native alternative that compiles models into pure Boolean circuits executable via bitwise CPU operations. Through rigorous iso-parameter experiments across four EEG datasets spanning two classification tasks, binary dementia detection and 3-class emotion recognition, we compared Diff-Logic against matched-capacity Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and Binarized Neural Network (BNN) baselines at four complexity tiers (50k-500k parameters). On dementia screening, Diff-Logic achieved 80.2% Macro F1, outperforming the MLP baseline by 6.8%. On emotion recognition, the MLP retained a moderate performance advantage but incurred a 2.3$\times$ higher latency and 14$\times$ larger model size when deployed on a power-constrained (7W) Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano CPU (Single-core). Critically, Diff-Logic inference time remained nearly constant across a 10$\times$ increase in model scale, achieving a peak speedup of 2.9$\times$ over MLPs at the largest complexity tier. Our results establish logic-based neural architectures as a practical paradigm for resource-constrained brain-computer interfaces, achieving competitive or superior performance while natively satisfying the latency and memory constraints of portable edge deployment. Code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/Shyamal-Dharia/eeg-difflogic
2607.18149.paper_summary_zh: 即時腦電圖（EEG）分類在邊緣設備上受到傳統神經網絡浮點運算的瓶頸。我們研究了可微分邏輯閘網絡（Diff-Logic）作為一種硬體原生替代方案，將模型編譯成可通過位元運算的CPU操作執行的純布林電路。通過在四個EEG數據集上進行嚴格的等參數實驗，涵蓋兩個分類任務：二元癡呆檢測和三類情緒識別，我們將Diff-Logic與匹配容量的多層感知器（MLP）和二元神經網絡（BNN）基準進行比較，並在四個複雜度層級（50k-500k參數）中進行測試。在癡呆篩查中，Diff-Logic達到了80.2%的宏觀F1，超越了MLP基準6.8%。在情緒識別中，MLP保持了適度的性能優勢，但在部署於受限於功耗（7W）的Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano CPU（單核心）時，延遲增加了2.3倍，模型大小則增大了14倍。關鍵是，Diff-Logic的推理時間在模型規模增加10倍的情況下幾乎保持不變，在最大複雜度層級上達到了相對於MLP的峰值加速比2.9倍。我們的結果確立了基於邏輯的神經架構作為資源受限的腦-機介面的實用範式，在滿足可攜式邊緣部署的延遲和記憶體限制的同時，實現了具有競爭力或更優的性能。代碼可在GitHub上獲得：https://github.com/Shyamal-Dharia/eeg-difflogic
